title: SEG Refines Edge
description: Schema for a Refines edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: child Requirement → parent Requirement. The child requirement declares what it refines via the sphinx-needs links: field. Strong-propagation edge: a change to either endpoint marks this edge suspect and notifies the Requirements Engineer. Resolution requires human affirmation by the Requirements Engineer.

seg:from.description: IRI of the child Requirement node — the one that refines.

seg:to.description: IRI of the parent Requirement node — the one being refined.
